info.name: Dental Clinic … Complete API Collection
info.description:
All 60+ API endpoints for the  Dental Clinic Portal & Practice Management System.
Version: 2.0 (Full Server — EC2 Ubuntu · Node.js · MySQL · Redis · Bull · PDFKit)
Author: Akib Tamboli — Solutions Architect
Base URL variable: {{base_url}} — set to http://localhost:3000/v1 for local dev

SETUP:
1. Import this collection
2. Import the _Dental_ENV.json environment file
3. Run '🔐 Auth → Login — Doctor' first to populate access_token
4. All other requests auto-use {{access_token}}

MOCK UUIDs: See '🌱 Mock Data Reference' folder

item.name: 🦷 Treatment Cases
item.description: Multi-step treatments — RCT, Implant, Orthodontics, Pulpectomy

request.description: Creates RCT case for Priya. Pre-fills 4 steps automatically.
Creates implant case for Ramesh. 3 steps pre-filled. healing_window_end set after Step 1.
Creates ortho case with variable step count.
Creates paediatric pulpectomy case. 3 steps pre-filled.
Returns case with all 4 steps, linked appointments, and per-step invoices.

item.name: Get Implant Case — with Healing Window

request.description: Implant case after Step 1 — shows healing_window_end date.
Update clinical notes on the case.
Marks Step 1 (Access Opening) as complete. Triggers per-step WA + invoice.
Marks Step 2 (BMP & Obturation) complete.
Completes implant placement. Sets healing_window_end = today + 90 days.
⚠️ Expect 400 — healing window not yet complete. days_remaining returned.
Closes case. Generates consolidated final invoice. Creates 12-month recall Bull job.

item.name: 🧾 Invoices
item.description: Invoice generation, GST classification, PDF, WA delivery

request.description: SAC 9993, 0% GST → plain receipt. Enqueues pdfQueue job. Returns immediately.
Partial invoice for RCT Step 1. SAC 9993, 0% GST.
Implant product/material — 5% GST applies. Generates GST invoice with GSTIN.
Cosmetic — SAC 999722, 18% GST. Generates full GST invoice.
Final consolidated invoice for completed RCT case.
Returns invoice details + presigned S3 PDF URL (15-min TTL).
All invoices paginated.
Filter by patient.
Only GST invoices (cosmetic).
Invoices in date range.
Re-enqueues invoice_ready WA job. Use when patient says they didn't receive it.

item.name: 🔔 Recalls
item.description: Recall scheduling, due list, manual send, cancel

request.description: All recalls due this week across all services.
Only overdue recalls (scheduled_at < now).
Filter overdue recalls by service.
Manually trigger a recall WA immediately. Enqueues to waQueue with delay=0.
Cancel a scheduled recall. Removes Bull job from Redis by bull_job_id.
Monthly recall stats — sent, rebooked, failed counts and conversion rate.

item.name: 📊 Dashboard
item.description: Schedule overview, revenue, analytics, queue health

request.description: Today's appointments grouped by chair. Includes no-show count and GST flag.
Revenue for each day this week.
Revenue per week for the last 8 weeks.
Revenue per month for current financial year.
Count and revenue grouped by service_id for current month.
WA message counts for today — queued, sent, delivered, read, failed.
Patients with overdue recalls. Used for dashboard recall badge count.
Bull queue stats — waiting, active, completed, failed per queue (waQueue, pdfQueue, recallQueue).
